hook: $13.99 for 6 organizers beats a $180 closet system

scenes.visual_prompt: Shot of a cramped dorm room closet, barely wider than a doorway, shoes stacked on the floor
scenes.voiceover: If your closet is a dorm room or a first apartment, you're not spending $180 on shoe storage.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing the Closet Organizers Pack of 6, laying out the six separate pieces
scenes.voiceover: This pack is $13.99 for six separate organizers, not one rack — so you use one or two for shoes and the rest for whatever else.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand assembling one piece and placing shoes into it inside the small closet
scenes.voiceover: It's got the largest review base of any pick I found, 8,851 reviews, from actual dorm and apartment setups.

scenes.visual_prompt: Text overlay: '4.0 stars — not built for a decade'
scenes.on_screen_text: built for a school year, not a decade
scenes.voiceover: The tradeoff is durability — reviewers say it holds up for a school year or a lease, not forever.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of the finished closet, shoes off the floor, organizers filling remaining gaps with bins
scenes.voiceover: For a temporary living situation, that's the honest tradeoff for the price.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final comparison card showing this pick next to the $89.99 and $179.99 options
scenes.voiceover: Full comparison of all five picks by closet size is on the blog.

caption: You don't need a $180 closet system for a dorm room. This $13.99 pack of 6 organizers has 8,851 reviews behind it. Full breakdown of all 5 picks by closet size on the blog, link in bio.
